Name: Target Acquisition
Details:
Your objective is to deploy beacons to target a facility. Triangulating the Facility will allow friendly faction forces to make their move. Facilities may have advanced Anti Aircraft Defenses, as well as ground forces. This mission is Time Boxed. So bring Fast 'Mechs and move quickly.

Expected Forces: <color=#F8A194>8–12+ 'Mechs</color>
